title: LIST: ​Prosecutor reveals some of 24 witnesses proposed by VP Sara defense
summary: Rep. Joel Chua, a member of the House prosecution panel, disclosed that the defense submitted on Wednesday a manifestation and request for the issuance of subpoenas for its proposed witnesses.
